record.field: Local Kubernetes cluster using Kind for development and testing

div.p: Kind (Kubernetes in Docker) is a tool for running local Kubernetes clusters using Docker container "nodes".
This cluster is perfect for local development and testing of Kubernetes applications.
APPUiO is a managed Kubernetes platform provided by VSHN, offering enterprise-grade container orchestration.
This production-ready cluster includes advanced features like automated scaling, monitoring, and security.
